source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of exception handling (PDF 60).

blocks.text: Exception handling woh tareeqa hai jis se program chalte waqt aane wali ghaltiyan (errors) sambhali jati hain. Ghalti aaye to program crash hone ki bajaye chalta reh sakta hai ya saleeqe se band ho sakta hai. Is se code zyada mazboot banta hai.

blocks.prompt: Program crash hone dene ki bajaye exceptions kyun sambhalein?
blocks.explanation: Ta ke program mufeed paigham dikha sake, sambhal sake ya saaf band ho, aur users ke liye zyada mazboot ho.

items: Exception handling: chalte program ki ghaltiyan sambhalna, crash se bachna.
